title.en: Prioritizing Client Care: Leadership, Delegation, and Emergency Response Planning
title.zh: 照護優先順序：領導、委派與緊急應變計畫

overview.en: This chapter covers health care delivery and insurance, nursing delivery models, leadership and management, quality improvement, change and conflict, the health care team, delegation and assignment, prioritizing care, and disaster response and triage. It is the core reference for prioritization and delegation questions.
overview.zh: 本章涵蓋醫療照護體系與保險、護理提供模式、領導與管理、品質改善、變革與衝突、醫療團隊、委派與指派、照護優先順序，以及災難應變與檢傷，是優先順序與委派題的核心參考。

heading.en: Care delivery systems, insurance and critical pathways
heading.zh: 照護提供系統、保險與臨床路徑

points.en: Managed care controls costs through outcome-driven care, health promotion, early detection and efficient resource use; case management supports it with an interprofessional approach.
points.zh: 管理式照護以成果導向、健康促進、早期發現與有效利用資源控制成本；個案管理以跨專業方式支持之。

points.en: Case manager (RN): assesses, plans, coordinates referrals and services, facilitates discharge, advocates for cost-effective care and knows insurance options.
points.zh: 個案管理師（RN）：評估、計畫、協調轉介與服務、促進出院、倡導具成本效益的照護並熟悉保險。

points.en: Insurance types: HMO, PPO, EPO, POS, HDHP, HSA. Medicare: age 65+, some disabled, ESRD (Part A hospital/SNF/hospice, Part B outpatient 80%, Part C private plan, Part D drugs). Medicaid: joint federal-state for low income.
points.zh: 保險類型：HMO、PPO、EPO、POS、HDHP、HSA。Medicare：65 歲以上、部分身障者、末期腎病（A 部分住院/SNF/安寧、B 部分門診 80%、C 部分私人計畫、D 部分藥物）。Medicaid：聯邦與州合辦的低收入保險。

points.en: Critical pathway: evidence-based, time-framed care plan; variation analysis compares actual to expected outcomes to spot negative variance early.
points.zh: 臨床路徑：循證、設定時間的照護計畫；變異分析比較實際與預期結果，及早發現負向變異。

points.en: Care planning tools: nursing care plan, ADPIE, nursing process, SBAR, SOAP, NCJMM.
points.zh: 照護規劃工具：護理計畫、ADPIE、護理過程、SBAR、SOAP、NCJMM。

points.en: Functional nursing: task-oriented, efficient for many clients but fragmented with low accountability.
points.zh: 功能制護理：以工作為導向，可照顧較多病人但照護片段且責任分散。

points.en: Team nursing: an RN team leader assesses, plans and evaluates; staff work within their scope (e.g., RN leading 2 LPNs and 3 APs for 12 clients).
points.zh: 小組護理：RN 組長負責評估、計畫與評值；成員在各自範圍內工作（例：RN 帶 2 位 LPN 與 3 位 AP 照顧 12 位病人）。

points.en: Relationship-based (primary) nursing: one primary nurse manages care from admission to discharge, with an associate when off duty.
points.zh: 關係導向（責任制）護理：由一位責任護理師從入院到出院負責，輪休時由輔助護理師接手。

points.en: Client-focused (total care/case method): the RN gives all needed care to assigned clients for the shift.
points.zh: 以病人為中心（全責/個案制）：RN 在該班次提供指派病人所有所需照護。

heading.zh: 責任、領導風格與管理者

points.en: Accountability: answerable for choices and actions; assume only responsibilities within competence; admit mistakes.
points.zh: 責任：對選擇與行動負責；只承擔能力範圍內的職責；承認錯誤。

points.en: Leadership influences others to achieve goals; management accomplishes tasks through oneself or others.
points.zh: 領導是影響他人達成目標；管理是自己或透過他人完成任務。

points.en: Styles: authoritarian (leader decides), democratic (participative), laissez-faire (passive), situational, bureaucratic (policies), transformational (shared vision), servant.
points.zh: 風格：權威式（領導者決定）、民主式（參與）、放任式（被動）、情境式、官僚式（依規定）、轉型式（共同願景）、服務式。

points.en: Management functions: planning, organizing, directing, controlling. Problem-solving steps parallel the nursing process and NCJMM.
points.zh: 管理功能：計畫、組織、指導、控制。問題解決步驟與護理過程及 NCJMM 平行。

points.en: Managers: front-line (charge nurse, team leader), middle (unit manager, supervisor), nurse executive.
points.zh: 管理者：第一線（組長、領導護理師）、中階（單位主任、督導）、護理主管。

points.en: Power types: reward, coercive, referent, expert, legitimate, personal, informational; empowerment enables others through open communication and shared decisions.
points.zh: 權力類型：獎賞、強制、參照、專家、法定、個人、資訊；賦權透過開放溝通與共同決策使他人有能力。

heading.en: Organizations, evidence-based practice and quality improvement
heading.zh: 組織、實證護理與品質改善

points.en: Mission, goals, organizational chart; policies guide, procedures describe methods, protocols prescribe care for a specific problem. Centralized vs decentralized decision-making.
points.zh: 使命、目標、組織圖；政策提供方向、程序說明方法、準則規範特定問題的照護。集權與分權決策。

points.en: Evidence-based practice integrates best research, clinical expertise and client preferences; nurses question practice and formulate researchable questions. Level I evidence (reviews of RCTs) is strongest.
points.zh: 實證護理整合最佳研究、臨床專業與病人偏好；護理師質疑現行作法並提出可研究的問題。第 I 級證據（多個 RCT 回顧）最強。

points.en: Quality improvement monitors outcomes against standards; retrospective audits review charts after discharge, concurrent audits evaluate during care; peer review evaluates colleagues' care.
points.zh: 品質改善依標準監測成果；回溯稽核在出院後查閱病歷，同步稽核於照護期間評估；同儕審查評估同事的護理品質。

points.en: Lewin's change model: unfreezing (identify problem, gather evidence), moving/changing (plan and implement), refreezing (stabilize).
points.zh: 勒溫變革模式：解凍（辨識問題、蒐集證據）、移動/改變（規劃與執行）、再凍結（穩定）。

points.en: Resistance reasons: conformity, habit, fear, secondary gains, threats to basic needs, differing values. Overcome by involving everyone, stressing benefits, evaluating progress and giving feedback; confront resistant staff to elicit feelings.
points.zh: 抗拒原因：從眾、習慣、恐懼、次級獲益、基本需求受威脅、價值差異。克服方法：全員參與、強調益處、持續評值與回饋；面質抗拒者以引導說出感受。

points.en: Conflict types: intrapersonal, interpersonal, organizational. Modes: avoidance, accommodation, competition, compromise (assertive and cooperative).
points.zh: 衝突類型：個人內在、人際、組織。處理方式：迴避、順應、競爭、妥協（堅定且合作）。

heading.en: Health care team and interprofessional collaboration
heading.zh: 醫療團隊與跨專業合作

points.en: Team roles: PHCP, PA, NP/APRN, PT, OT, respiratory therapist, speech therapist (swallowing), dietitian, continuing care nurse, pharmacist, social worker, chaplain, AP.
points.zh: 團隊角色：醫師、PA、NP/APRN、物理治療師、職能治療師、呼吸治療師、語言治療師（吞嚥）、營養師、延續照護護理師、藥師、社工、牧靈人員、助理。

points.en: Reports: factual, accurate, complete, organized; change-of-shift reports may be at the bedside; transfer reports include name, diagnosis, status, needs, allergies, resuscitation status.
points.zh: 報告：事實、準確、完整、有條理；交班可在床邊；轉送報告含姓名、診斷、狀況、需求、過敏與急救狀態。

points.en: SBAR: Situation, Background, Assessment, Recommendation. Telephone reports should be documented (when, who, what).
points.zh: SBAR：情況、背景、評估、建議。電話報告須記錄（時間、對象、內容）。

points.en: Consultation is sought when the problem exceeds nursing resources; rapid-response teams respond to early deterioration on non-ICU units to prevent arrest.
points.zh: 問題超出護理資源時尋求會診；快速反應小組處理非加護單位早期惡化以預防心肺停止。

points.en: Medication reconciliation: compare current and new medication lists at transitions, resolve discrepancies, communicate the final list.
points.zh: 藥物整合：在轉換照護時比對現用與新藥單、解決差異並傳達最終清單。

points.en: Discharge planning begins at admission; teach with teach-back about medications, diet, activity, complications, equipment, resources and follow-up.
points.zh: 出院準備自入院即開始；以回述教導藥物、飲食、活動、併發症、設備、資源與追蹤。

points.en: Delegation transfers a task to a competent person; the nurse keeps accountability. Five rights: task, circumstances, person, direction/communication, supervision/evaluation.
points.zh: 委派是將任務交給有能力者；護理師仍負責任。五項正確：任務、情境、人員、指示/溝通、督導/評值。

points.en: Cannot delegate nursing judgment or critical decision making (assessment, teaching initiation, planning, evaluation).
points.zh: 不可委派護理判斷或關鍵決策（評估、起始衛教、計畫、評值）。

points.en: AP: noninvasive tasks for stable clients. LPN/VN: stable clients, dressings, suctioning, catheterization, oral/SC/IM meds. RN: stable and unstable clients, IV meds, initial assessment and teaching.
points.zh: AP：穩定病人的非侵入性工作。LPN/VN：穩定病人、換藥、抽吸、導尿、口服/皮下/肌肉藥。RN：穩定與不穩定病人、靜脈給藥、初始評估與衛教。

points.en: Give clear directions, validate understanding, give feedback; match task to the nurse practice act and job description.
points.zh: 指示清楚、確認理解、給予回饋；依護理執業法與職務說明配對任務。

points.en: Time management: list tasks, prioritize, begin rounds early, delegate, document concurrently, evaluate the day.
points.zh: 時間管理：列出任務、排序、早班巡視、委派、同步記錄、評估當日。

points.en: Priorities are high (life-threatening), intermediate (nonemergency) or low (unrelated to illness); the client's own priorities count.
points.zh: 優先順序分高（危及生命）、中（非緊急）、低（與疾病無直接關係）；病人自己的優先事項也要考量。

points.en: Use ABCs, Maslow and nursing process (assessment first); CPR uses CAB; actual problems before potential ones; act on critically abnormal values.
points.zh: 使用 ABC、馬斯洛、護理過程（評估優先）；CPR 用 CAB；現存問題先於潛在問題；對嚴重異常值立即處理。

points.en: Group of clients: heart failure with 4-lb gain and dyspnea first, then fresh chest tube post-op, then absent bowel sounds, then pre-op teaching.
points.zh: 多位病人：心衰竭體重增加 4 磅且呼吸喘者優先，其次術後胸管，其次腸音消失，最後術前衛教。

points.en: Teaching priorities: immediate needs, client's perceived needs, anxiety level, time available.
points.zh: 衛教優先：立即需求、病人認為重要的事、焦慮程度、可用時間。

points.en: Internal disasters occur within the facility; external outside it; a mass casualty event exceeds hospital resources. Activate the emergency response plan immediately.
points.zh: 內部災難發生於機構內；外部災難發生於機構外；大規模傷亡超出醫院資源。立即啟動緊急應變計畫。

points.en: FEMA phases: mitigation, preparedness, response, recovery; three disaster levels (I massive to III minor). ARC provides free relief, shelters and crisis counseling; HAZMAT teams handle exposures.
points.zh: FEMA 階段：減災、整備、應變、復原；災難三級（I 級重大至 III 級輕微）。紅十字會提供免費救援、庇護與危機諮商；HAZMAT 處理暴露事件。

points.en: Triage: START tags in 30-60 seconds; ED triage emergent (red, priority 1), urgent (yellow, priority 2), nonurgent (green, priority 3); black for expected deaths. Think survivability.
points.zh: 檢傷：START 於 30-60 秒內分類；急診緊急（紅、第 1 優先）、次緊急（黃、第 2 優先）、非緊急（綠、第 3 優先）；黑色為預期死亡。思考可存活性。

points.en: Primary assessment (ABCs, check central pulse 5-10 seconds, agonal breathing needs ventilation) precedes secondary assessment (history, vital signs, neuro, pain, head-to-toe).
points.zh: 初級評估（ABC、中心脈搏檢查 5-10 秒、瀕死喘息需通氣）先於次級評估（病史、生命徵象、神經、疼痛、頭到腳）。

points.en: Personal preparedness: 3-day supply of water (1 gallon per person per day) and food, medications, radio, flashlight, documents; replace water every 3 months and food every 6 months.
points.zh: 個人整備：三天份飲水（每人每日 1 加侖）與食物、藥物、收音機、手電筒、證件；水每 3 個月、食物每 6 個月更換。

critical_points.en: Delegate only tasks within the delegatee's scope; the delegating nurse stays accountable.
critical_points.zh: 只委派在被委派者範圍內的任務；委派的護理師仍負責任。

critical_points.en: Five rights of delegation: task, circumstances, person, direction/communication, supervision/evaluation.
critical_points.zh: 委派五正確：任務、情境、人員、指示/溝通、督導/評值。

critical_points.en: Do not delegate assessment, teaching initiation, planning, evaluation or unstable clients.
critical_points.zh: 不可委派評估、起始衛教、計畫、評值或不穩定病人。

critical_points.en: AP tasks: ADLs, ambulation, skin care, collecting urine specimens, vitals on stable clients.
critical_points.zh: AP 工作：日常生活照護、行走、皮膚照護、收集尿液檢體、穩定病人量生命徵象。

critical_points.en: ED triage: chest pain, respiratory distress, trauma, acute neuro deficit, chemical eye splash = emergent (red).
critical_points.zh: 急診檢傷：胸痛、呼吸窘迫、外傷、急性神經缺損、眼睛化學物噴濺 = 緊急（紅）。

critical_points.en: Think survivability when triaging disaster victims; treat those who can be saved first.
critical_points.zh: 災難檢傷時考量可存活性；先救治有存活機會者。

critical_points.en: Closed chest-tube clients and unstable clients need assessment before stable teaching or discharge.
critical_points.zh: 胸管或不穩定病人須先於穩定病人的衛教或出院處理。

critical_points.en: Team nursing: RN leader directs a team (LPNs and APs); functional is task-based; primary is one nurse per client.
critical_points.zh: 小組護理：RN 組長領導 LPN 與 AP；功能制按工作分配；責任制由一位護理師負責一位病人。

critical_points.en: Lewin: unfreezing, moving, refreezing; confront resisting staff to explore feelings.
critical_points.zh: 勒溫：解凍、移動、再凍結；面質抗拒者以探索感受。

critical_points.en: Medicare Part B covers 80%; client pays 20% unless supplemental insurance.
critical_points.zh: Medicare B 部分給付 80%，其餘 20% 自付，除非有補充保險。

critical_points.en: Rapid-response team: call early for signs of deterioration to prevent arrest.
critical_points.zh: 快速反應小組：出現惡化徵象時及早呼叫以預防心肺停止。

critical_points.en: Disaster plan phases: mitigation, preparedness, response, recovery.
critical_points.zh: 災難計畫階段：減災、整備、應變、復原。

critical_points.en: Medication reconciliation at admission, transfer and discharge.
critical_points.zh: 在入院、轉床與出院時進行藥物整合。

critical_points.en: Report impaired staff or short staffing to administration; never abandon an assignment.
critical_points.zh: 通報受物質影響的同事或人力不足；不可擅離工作。

mnemonics.en: Management functions P-O-D-C: Planning, Organizing, Directing, Controlling.
mnemonics.zh: 管理功能 P-O-D-C：計畫、組織、指導、控制。

mnemonics.en: ED triage colors: Red = emergent, Yellow = urgent, Green = nonurgent, Black = expected death.
mnemonics.zh: 急診檢傷顏色：紅=緊急、黃=次緊急、綠=非緊急、黑=預期死亡。

stem.en: The nurse is bathing a client when an AP reports another client in pain. Most appropriate action?
stem.zh: 護理師正為病人擦澡，AP 報告另一位病人疼痛。最恰當作法？

options.en: Ask the AP to check the last dose time
options.zh: 請 AP 查最後給藥時間

options.en: Ask the AP to tell the client to wait
options.zh: 請 AP 告知病人等待

options.en: Cover the client, raise side rails, and give the pain medication
options.zh: 為病人蓋好、拉起床欄，再去給止痛藥

rationale.en: Ensure safety, then promptly treat pain; the AP cannot assess or decide medication.
rationale.zh: 確保安全後立即處理疼痛；AP 不可評估或決定給藥。

stem.en: The nurse manager changes from functional to team nursing and an AP resists. Best approach?
stem.zh: 護理長將功能制改為小組護理，AP 抗拒。最佳作法？

options.en: Confront to encourage the AP to verbalize feelings
options.zh: 面質以鼓勵 AP 說出感受

rationale.en: Resistance is best handled by open discussion and problem solving.
rationale.zh: 抗拒最好透過公開討論與問題解決處理。
